comment: A request for a describer to name an object or a room from a few images.

fields.name: subject_id
comment: The object ("O12") or room ("R3") the answer belongs to.

fields.name: images
comment: Best views, cropped for objects, whole frames for rooms.

fields.name: labels
comment: What the map already believes: label votes for an object, object labels for a room.
A describer's answer to a DescribeRequest.

fields.name: name
comment: Canonical name (1-3 words) and one-sentence caption, for objects.

fields.name: label_ok
comment: Whether the detector's label fits what the describer sees.

fields.name: room_type
comment: For rooms: one of the room types in the world model's table.

fields.name: model
comment: Which backend answered, for logs only.
An opening between two rooms, found where their regions touch.

fields.name: width
comment: Clear width at the narrowest point, m.
One segmented instance, cropped to its own bounding box: a full 848x480 mask is about 400 kB
per instance, the crop of a small object a few kB.

fields.name: label
comment: The phrase the detector was asked for, not the model's wording: object ids are built from it.

fields.name: score
comment: Detector confidence, calibrated or a bare ranking depending on the model. Carried through to
the hypothesis score on /objects.

fields.name: roi
comment: Where the crop sits in the full image.

fields.name: data
comment: roi.height * roi.width bytes, row major, 0 outside the instance and 255 inside. Bytes rather
than packed bits, since erosion works on bytes.

fields.name: embedding
comment: Image embedding of the instance's crop, L2-normalised, from whichever embedder the server runs.
Empty when the detector does not embed.
Every instance a detector found in one frame.

fields.name: header
comment: Stamp and frame of the source IMAGE, not the publish time: detection takes over a second, and
the geometry node pairs on this stamp to find the matching depth frame.

fields.name: image_width
comment: Size of the image the ROIs index into, so a consumer can refuse a mismatched depth frame.

fields.name: model
comment: The model that produced them, for logs only. Nothing branches on it, so the segmenter can be
swapped without touching anything downstream.
A region of the map, segmented from the occupancy grid. Frame from the enclosing array.

fields.name: id
comment: Stable across re-segmentation: "R3". Never reused.

fields.name: name
comment: What people call it: "room C", or a name an operator gave it.

fields.name: type
comment: "kitchen", "office", ...; empty until typed. `type_source` says what decided it: objects,
describer or operator.

fields.name: floor_coverage
comment: Fractions of the observable targets seen well enough by the camera, 0..1.

fields.name: unobservable_cells
comment: Targets no reachable standing pose can see, e.g. a shelf above camera height.
One object the world model fused from several views. Poses are in the header frame of the
enclosing array, normally `map`.

fields.name: id
comment: Stable for the life of the world file: "O12". Never reused after removal.

fields.name: label
comment: The detector label with the most votes.

fields.name: name
comment: Canonical name and one-line caption from the describer. Empty until described.

fields.name: confidence
comment: Share of all label votes held by `label`, 0..1.

fields.name: room_id
comment: Room the footprint centre falls in, and the object it rests on. Empty when unknown or on the
floor.

fields.name: pose
comment: Centre of the oriented bounding box; only yaw is set in the orientation.

fields.name: size
comment: Full extents along the box axes, m.

constants.name: STATE_ACTIVE
comment: Stale: looked at and not found; removed: looked at and not found repeatedly. Kept rather than
deleted so a query can still say where the object used to be.
Objects matching a label, name or free text, best first.

fields.name: room
comment: Room id or name to search in; empty searches everywhere.

fields.name: query_embedding
comment: Optional text embedding of the query, from the same model as the objects' embeddings.

fields.name: found
comment: False with a coverage figure means "not in the part the camera has seen", not "absent".
A reachable pose facing a target, for NavigateToPose.

fields.name: target
comment: Object id ("O12"), room id or name, or a label to search for.

fields.name: room
comment: Narrows a label search to one room; empty for anywhere.

fields.name: standoff
comment: Distance kept from the object's footprint, m; 0 uses the node's default.
Where to stand and which way to look next. Called in a loop by the exploration tree.

constants.name: MODE_FRONTIER
comment: "frontier" closes the map under SLAM; "coverage" makes the camera see what the map holds.

fields.name: pose
comment: Where to stand; the yaw is the first heading.

fields.name: headings
comment: Map-frame yaws to face in turn once there, rad.

fields.name: expected_gain
comment: Target cells the view is predicted to cover.

constants.name: STATUS_UNAVAILABLE
comment: Not now: no map or pose yet, or the map has not caught up with the last viewpoint. Ask again.

constants.name: STATUS_STUCK
comment: The last viewpoints were all unreached from here: move the robot off, then ask again.
Tells the planner how a viewpoint went, so an unreachable one is not offered forever.
